description: Agent IP Records: submit prosecution and office-action records with the responses, docket and portfolio they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each office action with its id, reference, the application serial number, the moment issued, the response deadline it states and whether it is a final refusal; each response, amendment or appeal with its id, reference, the office action it answers, the application, the moment filed and its kind; each docket entry with its id, the application, the response it shows and the status it records; each portfolio listing with its id, the application and the status it lists. The signed report gives the office actions and the responses, each office action against a response recorded by its deadline, each response against the docket entry that shows it, each application the docket shows abandoned against the status the portfolio lists, and each final refusal against an appeal or amendment noted, and counts them, and names divergent prosecution records: an office action recorded with no response recorded before its stated deadline, a response filed that the docket does not show, an application the docket shows abandoned while the portfolio still lists it active, and a final refusal recorded with no appeal or amendment noted; then a response naming an office action the records do not hold and a docket entry showing a response the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No office actions, an office action with no response deadline, or an unanswered office action with no reading moment leaves those points unverified. Office actions, responses, docket entries and portfolio listings match by letters and digits, a response to its office action by the action reference, a response counts as timely when filed on or before the stated deadline by the day, an unanswered office action before its deadline waits, a final refusal reads as answered only by an appeal or an amendment, and filed, pending, published, allowed and registered read as active. This reads the substance of each office action and the response on file for its matter. Verdict ip_prosecution_divergent, ip_prosecution_partial, ip_prosecution_unverified or ip_prosecution_consistent. POST /api/ip-prosecution-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.

deadline.description: The response deadline the office action states, such as 2026-03-02.

final.description: Whether the office action is a final refusal.

as_of.description: The moment the prosecution records are read at, such as 2026-03-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

responses.description: Each response, amendment or appeal filed.
